name: Rust Remote Builder
postCreateCommand:
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y mold clang sccache && mkdir -p ~/.cargo && cat << 'EOF' > ~/.cargo/config.toml
[target.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu]
linker = "clang"
rustflags = ["-C", "link-arg=-fuse-ld=mold"]

[build]
rustc-wrapper = "sccache"
EOF
